1 /**
2  * Shared subscription-CLI policy for Trio and Foundry seats.
3  *
4  * Persist intent (latest supported / highest supported), never a release name.
5  * Capability discovery and the resulting selection are separate from a served-
6  * model attestation: only a provider's actual turn receipt can supply the latter.
7  * No Anchor imports, private project paths, API clients, or permission overrides.
8  */
9 import fs from 'node:fs';
10 import os from 'node:os';
11 import path from 'node:path';
12 import { execFileSync } from 'node:child_process';
13 import { reconcileCodexCatalog } from './codex-catalog.mjs';
14 
15 export const DEFAULT_POLICY = Object.freeze({
16   mode: 'latest_supported',
17   effort: 'highest_supported',
18 });
19 export const POLICY_VERSION = 1;
20 const FAMILIES = new Set(['claude', 'chatgpt', 'grok', 'gemini']);
21 const EFFORTS = ['none', 'minimal', 'low', 'medium', 'high', 'xhigh', 'max', 'ultra'];
22 const MODEL_ID = /^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:/-]{0,199}$/;
23 const TTL_MS = 300_000;
24 const MAX_BYTES = 8 * 1024 * 1024;
25 const GROK_ORIGIN = 'https://cli-chat-proxy.grok.com/v1/models';
26 const cache = new Map();
27 let discovererIds = new WeakMap();
28 let nextDiscovererId = 1;

30 export class PolicyUnavailable extends Error {
31   constructor(family, reason, code = 'model_policy_unavailable') {
32     super(`${family || 'settings'}: ${reason}`);
33     this.name = 'PolicyUnavailable';
34     this.family = family || null;
35     this.code = code;
36     // Discovery/settings failed before a provider action was submitted. This is
37     // an internal prelaunch receipt for the configured-family failover ladder,
38     // not a claim that any requested model served a turn.
39     this.seat_unavailable = true;
40     this.seat_status = code;
41     this.raw_receipt = {
42       ok: false, status: code, error: this.message, replay_safe: true,
43       model_served: null, model_attested: false, family_attested: false,
44     };
45   }
46 }

49   throw new PolicyUnavailable(family, reason, code);

61 export function validatePolicy(policy = DEFAULT_POLICY) {
62   if (!object(policy) || Object.keys(policy).some(key => !Object.hasOwn(DEFAULT_POLICY, key))
63       || policy.mode !== DEFAULT_POLICY.mode || policy.effort !== DEFAULT_POLICY.effort) {
64     fail(null, 'The model policy must request latest_supported and highest_supported.', 'settings_invalid');
65   }
66   return { ...DEFAULT_POLICY };
67 }

69 function validatePrefs(raw, source) {
70   if (!object(raw) || raw.settings_error) fail(null, 'Model preferences are invalid.', 'settings_invalid');
71   for (const key of ['coding_family', 'review_family', 'default_cli']) {
72     if (!FAMILIES.has(raw[key])) fail(null, `Missing or invalid ${key}.`, 'settings_invalid');
73   }
74   const revision = raw.settings_revision === undefined ? 0 : raw.settings_revision;
75   if (!Number.isSafeInteger(revision) || revision < 0) {
76     fail(null, 'settings_revision must be a nonnegative safe integer.', 'settings_invalid');
77   }
78   return {
79     coding_family: raw.coding_family,
80     review_family: raw.review_family,
81     default_cli: raw.default_cli,
82     model_policy: validatePolicy(raw.model_policy === undefined ? DEFAULT_POLICY : raw.model_policy),
83     settings_revision: revision,
84     source: source || raw.source || 'provided-settings',
85   };

92 function readJson(filename, family, errorCode = 'model_policy_unavailable') {
93   try {
94     const stat = fs.statSync(filename);
95     if (!stat.isFile() || stat.size > MAX_BYTES) fail(family, 'The metadata file is not a bounded regular file.', errorCode);
96     return JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(filename, 'utf8'));
97   } catch (error) {
98     if (error instanceof PolicyUnavailable) throw error;
99     // Do not expose file contents, provider stderr, credentials, or JSON excerpts.
100     fail(family, 'Cannot read valid provider metadata or preferences.', errorCode);
101   }
102 }

104 function present(filename) {
105   try {
106     fs.statSync(filename);
107     return true;
108   } catch (error) {
109     if (error.code === 'ENOENT') return false;
110     fail(null, 'Cannot inspect the authoritative preference file.', 'settings_invalid');

114 /**
115  * An existing primary is authority, even if corrupt. Only an absent primary
116  * allows the mirror to serve as authority. primary_path metadata is ignored.
117  * A standalone Trio install with neither file retains historical Claude seats;
118  * Anchor itself has a stricter first-run setup gate before launching a seat.
119  */
120 export function loadPolicyPrefs(env = process.env) {
121   const mirror = path.join(profileDirectory(env), '.anchor', 'model_prefs.json');
122   const primary = env.ANCHOR_DATA_DIR ? path.join(env.ANCHOR_DATA_DIR, 'settings.json') : null;
123   if (primary && present(primary)) return validatePrefs(readJson(primary, null, 'settings_invalid'), 'primary');
124   if (present(mirror)) return validatePrefs(readJson(mirror, null, 'settings_invalid'), 'mirror');
125   return validatePrefs({
126     coding_family: 'claude', review_family: 'claude', default_cli: 'claude',
127     model_policy: DEFAULT_POLICY, settings_revision: 0,
128   }, 'historical-default');
129 }

131 function modelId(value, family) {
132   if (typeof value !== 'string' || MODEL_ID.exec(value)?.[0] !== value) fail(family, 'The catalog contains an invalid model identifier.');
133   return value;
134 }

136 function effortValues(values, family) {
137   if (!Array.isArray(values) || !values.length) fail(family, 'The provider did not advertise supported reasoning efforts.');
138   return [...new Set(values.map(value => {
139     const effort = typeof value === 'string' ? value
140       : value?.effort ?? value?.reasoningEffort ?? value?.value ?? value?.id;
141     if (typeof effort !== 'string' || !EFFORTS.includes(effort)) {
142       fail(family, 'The provider advertised an unknown reasoning effort; capability support must be updated.');
143     }
144     return effort;
145   }))];
146 }
147 
148 export function highestEffort(values, family = null) {
149   const supported = effortValues(values, family);
150   return EFFORTS.filter(value => supported.includes(value)).at(-1);
151 }
152 
153 function upgradeId(value, family) {
154   if (value === undefined || value === null || value === '') return undefined;
155   return modelId(typeof value === 'string' ? value : value?.model ?? value?.id, family);
156 }

158 function hidden(entry) {
159   return entry.hidden === true || entry.isHidden === true || entry.selectable === false
160     || entry.visibility === 'hide' || entry.visibility === 'hidden' || entry.visibility === 'none';
161 }

163 function claudeEfforts(raw) {
164   if (Array.isArray(raw?.efforts)) return effortValues(raw.efforts, 'claude');
165   if (Array.isArray(raw?.supportedEfforts)) return effortValues(raw.supportedEfforts, 'claude');
166   const help = typeof raw === 'string' ? raw : raw?.help;
167   if (typeof help !== 'string') fail('claude', 'Claude effort capability help is unavailable.');
168   const lines = help.split(/\r?\n/);
169   const at = lines.findIndex(line => /--effort\b/.test(line));
170   if (at < 0) fail('claude', 'The installed Claude CLI does not advertise effort selection.');
171   let declaration = lines[at];
172   for (let index = at + 1; index < Math.min(at + 4, lines.length); index++) {
173     if (/^\s+-/.test(lines[index])) break;
174     declaration += ` ${lines[index]}`;
175   }
176   const choices = declaration.match(/\((?:choices:\s*)?([a-zA-Z"'\s,|/-]+)\)/);
177   if (!choices) fail('claude', 'Claude did not expose a parseable effort capability list.');
178   return effortValues(choices[1].split(/[\s,|/]+/).map(value => value.replace(/["']/g, '')).filter(Boolean), 'claude');
179 }
180 
181 function normalizedRows(family, entries) {
182   if (!Array.isArray(entries) || !entries.length) fail(family, 'The provider catalog contains no selectable models.');
183   const seen = new Set();
184   return entries.map((entry, index) => {
185     if (!object(entry)) fail(family, 'The model catalog contains an invalid entry.');
186     const model = modelId(entry.model, family);
187     if (seen.has(model)) fail(family, 'The model catalog contains duplicate identifiers.');
188     seen.add(model);
189     const rank = entry.rank ?? index;
190     if (!Number.isFinite(rank)) fail(family, 'The provider model rank is invalid.');
191     const result = { model, efforts: effortValues(entry.efforts, family), rank };
192     const upgrade = upgradeId(entry.upgrade, family);
193     if (upgrade) result.upgrade = upgrade;
194     return result;
195   });
196 }

198 /** Retains capability fields only, never prompts, API keys, headers or config. */
199 export function normalizeCatalog(family, raw) {
200   familyName(family);
201   if (family === 'gemini') {
202     fail(family, 'The agy subscription adapter has no verified latest/highest capability contract.', 'capability_unsupported');
203   }
204   let entries;
205   let evidence;
206   let warning;
207   if (raw?.schema_version === 1) {
208     if (raw.family !== family) fail(family, 'Capability catalog family mismatch.');
209     entries = normalizedRows(family, raw.models);
210     evidence = family === 'claude' ? 'provider_moving_alias'
211       : family === 'grok' ? 'provider_catalog_order'
212         : raw.selection_evidence === 'installed_cli_priority+native_capabilities' ? raw.selection_evidence
213           : raw.selection_evidence === 'provider_catalog_order' ? 'provider_catalog_order' : 'provider_priority';
214   } else if (family === 'chatgpt') {
215     const models = Array.isArray(raw?.models) ? raw.models : raw?.data;
216     if (!Array.isArray(models)) fail(family, 'Codex did not return a model catalog.');
217     const visible = models.filter(entry => object(entry) && !hidden(entry));
218     evidence = raw._codex_catalog_evidence ? 'installed_cli_priority+native_capabilities'
219       : visible.every(entry => Number.isFinite(entry.priority)) ? 'provider_priority' : 'provider_catalog_order';
220     entries = normalizedRows(family, visible.map((entry, index) => ({
221       model: entry.slug ?? entry.model ?? entry.id,
222       efforts: entry.supported_reasoning_levels ?? entry.supportedReasoningEfforts,
223       rank: evidence !== 'provider_catalog_order' ? entry.priority : index,
224       upgrade: entry.upgrade,
225     })));
226   } else if (family === 'grok') {
227     const models = raw?.models ?? raw?.data;
228     if (!object(models) && !Array.isArray(models)) fail(family, 'Grok did not return a model catalog.');
229     const items = Object.entries(models).map(([key, value]) => ({ key, info: value?.info ?? value }));
230     entries = normalizedRows(family, items.filter(item => object(item.info) && !hidden(item.info)).map((item, index) => ({
231       model: item.info.model ?? item.info.id ?? item.key,
232       efforts: item.info.reasoning_efforts ?? item.info.supportedReasoningEfforts,
233       rank: index,
234     })));
235     evidence = 'provider_catalog_order';
236   } else {
237     entries = normalizedRows(family, [{ model: 'best', efforts: claudeEfforts(raw), rank: 0 }]);
238     evidence = 'provider_moving_alias';
239   }
240   if (family === 'grok') {
241     warning = 'Provider catalog order is used; the provider does not attest an explicit latest/frontier rank.';
242   } else if (family === 'chatgpt' && evidence === 'provider_catalog_order') {
243     warning = 'Provider priority is unavailable; selection follows advertised catalog order.';
244   }
245   return {
246     schema_version: 1, family, models: entries, selection_evidence: evidence,
247     ...(warning ? { warning } : {}),
248   };
249 }
250 
251 export function selectModel(family, catalog) {
252   const normalized = normalizeCatalog(family, catalog);
253   const ranked = [...normalized.models].sort((left, right) => left.rank - right.rank);
254   if (family === 'chatgpt' && ranked.length > 1 && ranked[0].rank === ranked[1].rank) {
255     fail(family, 'Latest model ranking is ambiguous; refresh subscription capabilities.');
256   }
257   const byId = new Map(ranked.map(entry => [entry.model, entry]));
258   const visited = new Set();
259   let selected = ranked[0];
260   let upgraded = false;
261   while (selected.upgrade) {
262     if (visited.has(selected.model)) fail(family, 'The model upgrade links contain a cycle.');
263     visited.add(selected.model);
264     const successor = byId.get(selected.upgrade);
265     if (!successor) fail(family, 'The advertised model upgrade target is absent or unavailable.');
266     selected = successor;
267     upgraded = true;
268   }
269   return {
270     family, model: selected.model, effort: highestEffort(selected.efforts, family),
271     selection_evidence: upgraded ? `${normalized.selection_evidence}+provider_upgrade` : normalized.selection_evidence,
272     model_attested: false,
273     ...(normalized.warning ? { warning: normalized.warning } : {}),
274   };
275 }

277 /** Strip routing pins and API billing inputs, retaining subscription identity and permissions. */
278 export function policyEnvironment(env = process.env) {
279   const clean = { ...env };
280   const modelPins = new Set([
281     'ANTHROPIC_MODEL', 'CLAUDE_MODEL', 'CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL', 'CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL',
282     'GROK_DEFAULT_MODEL', 'GROK_MODEL', 'GROK_REASONING_EFFORT', 'CODEX_MODEL', 'CHATGPT_MODEL',
283     'CODEX_REASONING_EFFORT', 'OPENAI_MODEL', 'GEMINI_MODEL', 'GOOGLE_MODEL',
284     'TRIO_REASONING_EFFORT', 'TRIO_EFFORT',
285     'OPENAI_BASE_URL', 'OPENAI_API_BASE', 'ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL', 'XAI_BASE_URL', 'GROK_BASE_URL',
286     'CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK', 'CLAUDE_CODE_USE_VERTEX', 'CLAUDE_CODE_USE_FOUNDRY',
287   ]);
288   const providerKeys = /^(?:OPENAI|ANTHROPIC|XAI|GROK|CODEX|GEMINI|GOOGLE|GOOGLE_AI|AZURE_OPENAI|OPENROUTER)_API_KEY$/;
289   for (const key of Object.keys(clean)) {
290     const upper = key.toUpperCase();
291     if (modelPins.has(upper) || /^ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_.*_MODEL$/.test(upper)
292         || /^TRIO_MODEL/.test(upper) || /^TRIO_DRIVER_/.test(upper) || providerKeys.test(upper)
293         || upper === 'ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN' || upper === 'OPENAI_API_TOKEN' || upper === 'GROK_API_TOKEN') {
294       delete clean[key];
295     }
296   }
297   return clean;
298 }

300 function pathValue(env) {
301   return env.PATH ?? env.Path ?? env.path ?? '';
302 }

304 function executableFor(family, env) {
305   const base = { chatgpt: 'codex', grok: 'grok', claude: 'claude' }[family];
306   if (!base) return null;
307   const name = process.platform === 'win32' ? `${base}.exe` : base;
308   for (const directory of pathValue(env).split(path.delimiter).filter(Boolean)) {
309     const candidate = path.join(directory.replace(/^"|"$/g, ''), name);
310     try {
311       if (fs.statSync(candidate).isFile()) return fs.realpathSync(candidate);
312     } catch { /* Another PATH entry may contain the native subscription CLI. */ }
313   }
314   return null;
315 }

317 function probe(family, executable, args, env) {
318   try {
319     return execFileSync(executable, args, {
320       encoding: 'utf8', timeout: 25_000, maxBuffer: MAX_BYTES,
321       windowsHide: true, shell: false, env: policyEnvironment(env),
322       stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'],
323     });
324   } catch {
325     fail(family, 'The bounded subscription CLI capability probe failed.', 'capability_probe_failed');
326   }
327 }

329 function semver(value) {
330   return typeof value === 'string' ? value.match(/\b\d+\.\d+\.\d+(?:-[A-Za-z0-9.-]+)?(?:\+[A-Za-z0-9.-]+)?\b/)?.[0] : undefined;
331 }

333 export function discoverModelCapabilities(family, { env = process.env, executable = executableFor(family, env) } = {}) {
334   familyName(family);
335   if (family === 'gemini') return normalizeCatalog(family, null);
336   if (!executable) fail(family, 'A native subscription CLI is not available on PATH.', 'cli_unavailable');
337   if (family === 'chatgpt') {
338     let raw;
339     try { raw = JSON.parse(probe(family, executable, ['debug', 'models'], env)); }
340     catch (error) {
341       if (error instanceof PolicyUnavailable) throw error;
342       fail(family, 'Codex returned malformed capability JSON.');
343     }
344     let bundled;
345     try { bundled = JSON.parse(probe(family, executable, ['debug', 'models', '--bundled'], env)); }
346     catch { bundled = null; } // A unique current ranking needs no tie-break.
347     raw = reconcileCodexCatalog(raw, bundled);
348     return normalizeCatalog(family, raw);
349   }
350   if (family === 'claude') return normalizeCatalog(family, probe(family, executable, ['--help'], env));
351   const version = semver(probe(family, executable, ['--version'], env));
352   if (!version) fail(family, 'The installed Grok version could not be verified.');
353   probe(family, executable, ['models'], env);
354   const raw = readJson(path.join(profileDirectory(env), '.grok', 'models_cache.json'), family);
355   const fetched = typeof raw?.fetched_at === 'string' ? Date.parse(raw.fetched_at) : NaN;
356   const freshnessTimestamp = raw?.renewed_at ?? raw?.fetched_at;
357   const freshness = typeof freshnessTimestamp === 'string' ? Date.parse(freshnessTimestamp) : NaN;
358   const now = Date.now();
359   const age = now - freshness;
360   if (!Number.isFinite(fetched) || fetched > now || !Number.isFinite(freshness)
361       || freshness < fetched || age < 0 || age > TTL_MS) {
362     fail(family, 'Grok capability cache is stale or has an invalid timestamp.');
363   }
364   if (raw.auth_method !== 'session' || raw.origin !== GROK_ORIGIN || raw.grok_version !== version) {
365     fail(family, 'Grok capability cache does not match the subscription identity, origin, or installed CLI version.');
366   }
367   return normalizeCatalog(family, raw);
368 }

370 function statStamp(filename) {
371   try {
372     const stat = fs.statSync(filename);
373     return [filename, stat.dev, stat.ino, stat.size, stat.mtimeMs, stat.ctimeMs];
374   } catch (error) {
375     return [filename, error.code === 'ENOENT' ? 'absent' : 'unreadable'];
376   }
377 }

379 function provenance(family, env, executable) {
380   const profile = profileDirectory(env);
381   const codex = env.CODEX_HOME || path.join(profile, '.codex');
382   const claude = env.CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR || path.join(profile, '.claude');
383   const files = family === 'chatgpt'
384     ? [path.join(codex, 'auth.json'), path.join(codex, 'config.toml'), path.join(codex, 'models_cache.json')]
385     : family === 'grok'
386       ? ['config.toml', 'config.json', 'auth.json', 'session.json', 'models_cache.json'].map(name => path.join(profile, '.grok', name))
387       : [path.join(profile, '.claude.json'), path.join(claude, 'settings.json'), path.join(claude, '.credentials.json')];
388   if (executable) files.push(executable);
389   return [family, profile, pathValue(env), env.CODEX_HOME || '', env.CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR || '', files.map(statStamp)];
390 }

392 export function clearModelPolicyCache() {
393   cache.clear();
394   discovererIds = new WeakMap();
395   nextDiscovererId = 1;
396 }

398 /** Resolve once per seat/turn boundary; callers persist this frozen receipt. */
399 export function resolveModelPolicy(family, {
400   env = process.env, settings, force = false, discoverer = discoverModelCapabilities,
401 } = {}) {
402   familyName(family);
403   const prefs = settings === undefined ? loadPolicyPrefs(env) : validatePrefs(settings);
404   const executable = executableFor(family, env);
405   if (typeof discoverer !== 'function') fail(family, 'The capability discovery adapter is unavailable.');
406   if (!discovererIds.has(discoverer)) discovererIds.set(discoverer, nextDiscovererId++);
407   const keyFor = () => JSON.stringify([discovererIds.get(discoverer), provenance(family, env, executable)]);
408   let key = keyFor();
409   let entry = force ? null : cache.get(key);
410   if (!entry || Date.now() - entry.at > TTL_MS || Date.now() < entry.at) {
411     const catalog = normalizeCatalog(family, discoverer(family, { env: policyEnvironment(env), executable }));
412     const at = Date.now();
413     entry = { catalog, at, discovered_at: new Date(at).toISOString() };
414     // Discovery may refresh a provider cache or authentication/config metadata.
415     key = keyFor();
416     cache.set(key, entry);
417     if (cache.size > 64) cache.delete(cache.keys().next().value);
418   }
419   return {
420     ...selectModel(family, entry.catalog),
421     policy_version: POLICY_VERSION,
422     requested_policy: { ...prefs.model_policy },
423     settings_revision: prefs.settings_revision,
424     discovered_at: entry.discovered_at,
425   };
426 }

428 /** Caller retains its existing permission flags; these affect selection only. */
429 export function modelLaunchArgs(selection) {
430   const family = familyName(selection?.family);
431   const model = modelId(selection.model, family);
432   const effort = highestEffort([selection.effort], family);
433   if (family === 'chatgpt') return [
434     '--model', model,
435     '-c', `model_reasoning_effort=${JSON.stringify(effort)}`,
436     '-c', `agents.default_subagent_model=${JSON.stringify(model)}`,
437     '-c', `agents.default_subagent_reasoning_effort=${JSON.stringify(effort)}`,
438     '-c', 'forced_login_method="chatgpt"',
439   ];
440   if (family === 'grok') return ['--model', model, '--reasoning-effort', effort];
441   if (family === 'claude') return ['--model', model, '--effort', effort];
442   fail(family, 'The agy subscription adapter has no verified latest/highest launch contract.', 'capability_unsupported');
443 }
